d: China’s anti-corruption campaign has claimed another senior Communist Party figure. Shanghai party chief Chen Jining is under investigation for what Beijing calls “serious violations of discipline and the law” — language commonly used in corruption cases. But Chen’s fall stands out because of the political position he occupied. Chen had risen rapidly through China’s political system. He previously served as Beijing mayor, environment minister and president of Tsinghua University before taking charge of Shanghai in 2022.
